question: According to rules laid down by the International Football Association Board (IFAB), what can be the maximum length of a goal line in football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**90 m**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The International Football Association Board (IFAB) states that the maximum length of a goal line in football is 90 meters (100 yards).
 
• The minimum length is 45 meters (50 yards). 
 
• The IFAB also states that the touchline must be longer than the goal line.
 
• The minimum length of a touchline is 90 meters (100 yards), and the maximum is 120 meters (130 yards). 
 
• The IFAB maintains and updates the 17 laws of soccer.
 
• The laws are the only rules of association football that FIFA permits its members to use.
